en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3. It was narrated to us by Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakil who said it was narrated to us by Muhammad b. Yahya from Muhammad b. Ahmad from Muhammad b. al-Hussain from Muhammad b. Ismail from Salih b. ’Uqba from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who recites a couplet regarding Imam Husain (a.s.) and cries or makes a crying face he would get Paradise.”
